content: {"investigate": [{"tool": "sql", "query": "SELECT service, used_mb, quota_mb FROM storage WHERE service != 'sync-job' AND service != 'worker'", "why": "Check disk usage for other services to identify if there's a system-wide storage issue or if sync-job is the only service exceeding quota"}], "hypotheses": [{"service": "sync-job", "kind": "resource_exhaustion", "mechanism": "Sync-job exceeded disk quota (1044MB/1000MB) preventing ledger export writes, causing sync failures", "supporting": ["E17", "E3", "E6", "E35"], "refuting": [], "explains": ["E3", "E6", "E17"], "repair_plan": [{"action": "restart_service", "params": {"service": "sync-job"}}]}, {"service": "worker", "kind": "runtime_fault", "mechanism": "Worker process stuck in a state where it incorrectly reports disk quota errors despite having sufficient space (60MB/1000MB)", "supporting": ["E15", "E16", "E2", "E4", "E7", "E9", "E34", "E35"], "refuting": [], "explains": ["M2_error_burst", "M3_dead_letters", "E2", "E4", "E7", "E8", "E9", "E11", "E12", "E5", "E10", "E13"], "repair_plan": [{"action": "restart_service", "params": {"service": "worker"}}]}], "summary": "Sync-job has actual disk quota exhaustion, while worker has a runtime fault causing false disk quota errors."}
